seasonWindows.label: Snook harvest closed (FWC Southern Gulf — May–September)
seasonWindows.notes: FWC: Closed May 1 – September 30 in the region from ~27°04.727′N near Venice Municipal Airport south through Collier. Confirm same-day at https://myfwc.com/fishing/saltwater/recreational/snook/

seasonWindows.label: Snook harvest closed (FWC Gulf — December–February)
seasonWindows.notes: FWC: Closed December 1 – end of February. Confirm same-day at https://myfwc.com/fishing/saltwater/recreational/snook/

provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: seasonWindows from live FWC Snook page only (Southern Gulf boundary at 27°04.727′N / Venice; Charlotte Harbor falls in the May 1–Sep 30 + Dec–Feb closed pair).
